subject: Request: standard per-1M token rates + model list for hosted pilot
messages:
From: Claire Wong <claire@mediashift.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, MediaShift Procurement <procurement@mediashift.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: standard per-1M token rates + model list for hosted pilot

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for taking a look — were evaluating Redwoods hosted API for a July pilot and I need a baseline rate card to run our unit-econ model. Can you send MediaShift your standard per-1M token IO pricing (input vs output split) for the common hosted models you support? Specifically, wed like standard list rates (no discounts) for:
- small/medium family (e.g., redwood-1.3B / redwood-3B equivalents)
- mid family (e.g., redwood-7B / 13B equivalents)
- large family (approx. 34B+)

Two additional asks:
1) Do you bill input and output separately (per-token) or do you use a combined token count? Please include an explicit example calculation for a typical call (120 tokens input, 280 tokens output).
2) Any published volume discount thresholds / minimum commit levels we should model (pilot expected ~5M tokens/month, with potential to scale quickly).

I attached a short spreadsheet with our estimated usage profile so you can pick the right tier. Also please confirm whether embeddings are billed under the same rate or a separate SKU.

Attachment: MediaShift_Rate_Request.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet)

If easier, we can hop on a quick 30-min call — I'm available this week.

Thanks,
Claire Wong
Head of Integrations
MediaShift
claire@mediashift.ai | +1 (415) 555-0112
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Wong <claire@mediashift.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: standard per-1M token rates + model list for hosted pilot

Hi Claire — thanks for the note and for sending the usage spreadsheet. Quick answers up front: we bill input and output separately at our hosted IO rates; embeddings are billed on a separate per-embedding-unit SKU (I'll include that below). I've attached a short summary PDF with standard list rates.

Attachment: redwood_ratecard_summary.pdf (pdf)

Before I send a formal line-item table, two quick clarifying questions that help me recommend the optimal model family and call example:
- Typical sequence lengths across your calls (you listed averages, but are you seeing many long-tail >1k token requests?)
- Expected concurrency / real-time latency SLO (is sub-500ms important for the pilot?)

To answer your example: for a 120-in / 280-out call we would show the IO billing as: input tokens: 120 * rate_input; output tokens: 280 * rate_output. I will include a worked example per-model in the attached PDF.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call today at 2:00pm PT or tomorrow morning — happy to include Aditya (finance) to discuss volume discounting and commit pathways.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0223
https://redwood.ai/docs/pricing

From: Claire Wong <claire@mediashift.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: standard per-1M token rates + model list for hosted pilot

Hi Sergio — thanks for the quick reply and the attachment. A few clarifications to help you map us to the right family:
- Average request we sent is ~120 input tokens, average response ~280 output tokens; very few calls exceed 1k tokens.
- Latency: pilot is not latency-sensitive (sub-second fine), concurrency low (single-digit rps per region).
- Pilot target: ~5M tokens/month, but were modeling two scale scenarios (50M/mo and 200M/mo) for 6-12 months post-pilot.

Questions:
1) Can you include an explicit per-1M token example for each family (input vs output) and the combined bill for the example call at 5M, 50M, and 200M tiers?
2) Do you offer any short-term pilot credits or trial discounts for new customers evaluating performance?
3) Separate SKU for embeddings (yes/no) and if so, a ballpark per-1M-embedding-unit price would help.

If it helps, we can do 2pm PT today. Otherwise tomorrow 10am PT works.

Thanks,
Claire

Aditya — looping you in on MediaShift. They want standard list IO per-1M token rates + per-model worked example for 120/280 call across three model families and three scale tiers (5M / 50M / 200M). They called out embeddings separately.

Claire noted pilot is low concurrency and not latency sensitive; that pushes them to mid-family for cost/quality tradeoffs unless we recommend otherwise. Can you:
1) Share the current list rates by family (input/output per 1M tokens) and embeddings SKU ballpark;
2) Draft a simple worked example table showing the combined bill for a single 120/280 call extrapolated to 5M/50M/200M tokens;
3) Note any short-term pilot credit options or starter discounts we can offer (two-week trial credit or one-time pilot discount).

I'll take ownership of scheduling a 30-min call — proposing 2pm PT today.

Thanks,
Sergio
